I can't tell you why. The data records whether she has signed, not her reasons, and I won't guess at them.

Here's what the records do show for Lisa Morrow (lisa.morrow@starkpowdercoat.com):

| Document | Status | Her state | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement — Stark County Powder Coating Inc | sent, 15.8 days | pending | **reissue** |
| Powder Coating Services Renewal FY27 — Stark County Powder Coating Inc | sent, 15.8 days | pending | **reissue** |
| Supplier Code of Conduct & Conflict Minerals Acknowledgement 2026 — Lisa Morrow | expired | — | skip (expired is a final state) |

- **Every signing link on both open documents has expired.** A reminder would only point her to a dead link, so the verdict is to reissue them, not send a reminder.
- **Her state is "pending" on both, not "viewed."** The records don't show her opening either document.
- **Curtis Nagy (keystoneprecision.com) is also still pending on both,** so her signature isn't the only one missing.
- The Code of Conduct acknowledgement expired, so no further action is recommended for it.

I haven't changed anything. Reissuing the two documents needs a person's approval before the executor can do it. If you want to know why she hasn't signed, someone will have to ask her directly.
